# Architecture Decisions

## ADR-1 Spring Boot 4.1.2 on Java 21, generated by Spring Initializr
Latest stable release offered by start.spring.io at generation time (others were SNAPSHOT/RC). Java 21 is the LTS target. Boot 4 starters used: `spring-boot-starter-webmvc`, `-data-jpa`, `-validation`, `-actuator`, `-flyway` plus `flyway-database-postgresql`. Versions come from Boot dependency management.

## ADR-2 Package-by-feature
`university`, `program`, `requirement`, `source`, `tuition`, `country`, `common`. Layer sub-packages exist only where classes exist (no empty packages). No `config` package yet because no custom configuration is needed.

## ADR-3 Flyway owns the schema; Hibernate only validates
`ddl-auto: validate`. Applied migrations are immutable; every change is a new `V<n>__*.sql`. Integrity (unique, FK, CHECK constraints) lives in the database and is tested in `SchemaConstraintsIT`.

## ADR-4 Relational model with provenance
Universities and degree programs are separate. `academic_requirement` and `tuition_fee` are scoped by application cycle / academic year and **must** reference a `source` (`NOT NULL` FK). No facts are seeded; only synthetic test fixtures (ISO codes `XA`/`XB`).

## ADR-5 DTO-only API, whitelisted sorting, stable paging
Entities never reach JSON (records in `dto`, `UniversityMapper`). Sort fields are whitelisted (`name`, `city`) with `id` as tiebreaker; page size 1–100. Country is fetch-joined for list pages to avoid N+1; detail uses an `@EntityGraph`.

## ADR-6 Search via JPA Specifications
Name search is case-insensitive "contains" with `%`/`_` escaped so user input is literal. See mistake #1 for the Spring Data 4 null-spec rule.

## ADR-7 Centralised errors
`GlobalExceptionHandler` returns one `ApiError` shape; framework errors (unknown path, 405) keep their status instead of becoming 500.

## ADR-8 Test strategy
`*Test` = unit/slice tests without Docker (surefire). `*IT` = Testcontainers PostgreSQL 17 (failsafe, run in `verify`). One shared container per JVM.

## ADR-9 Configuration and secrets
Datasource from environment (`DB_URL`, `DB_USERNAME`, `DB_PASSWORD`), optional git-ignored `.env`. No default password exists anywhere. Compose refuses to start without `DB_PASSWORD`. Default host DB port is 5433 to avoid clashing with native PostgreSQL.
